editorial:
Imagine waking up every day seeing flashes of people dying. That is exactly what happens to the main character in this dark story. You get to follow a young man who is struggling to keep his head straight while these scary visions take over his mind. The vibe is very heavy and tense, making you feel like something bad is about to happen at any second. It is not your typical jump-scare movie; instead, it builds up a feeling of dread that makes you wonder if he is actually crazy or if there is something supernatural going on.

The acting is solid and makes the lead's struggle feel real. Some parts of the story move a bit slow, but the payoff at the end makes it worth the wait. If you like movies that mess with your head and leave you feeling uneasy, you will love this one.
endingExplained: The movie ends with the main character fully giving in to the violent voices in his head. He stops fighting the visions and starts acting on them, becoming the very thing he feared. The twist is that the visions were not just warnings, but a push toward a dark destiny. In the final scenes, he commits a terrible act, showing that he is now completely lost to the darkness with no hope of being saved.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and dark character studies.
